original.statement: Crossplane v2.0.0 removes the --registry CLI flag, requiring users to always specify fully qualified URLs when installing packages instead of relying on a default registry value.

decision.reason: [ev-792eae516f7e] says "Crossplane v2 drops the `--registry` flag that allowed users to specify a default registry value". [ev-430fc91e4c1d] in the upgrade guide confirms it: "Removed: `--registry` flag for default package registry". So subject cli-flag --registry with change type removed is correct. The upstream text also lists other breaking changes, but its --registry part maps exactly to this assertion. The assertion matches known fact vf-d36855dd939d.
